card.name: Inside/outside contrast words
card.fires_on: Words that mean inside or outside, such as exter(iors), internal, intr(acellular), inner and inside, where the text is setting inside against outside. It also fires on a few linking words before such a contrast.

modes.label: Outside/inside word starts
modes.description: Start of exter- or intr- words, or internal, in a contrast of outer and inner.
modes.example: what 1980s movie was filmed here,<< exter>>iors only.

modes.label: Inner body side
modes.description: Inner or inside describing the side of an arm or wrist.
modes.example: confirm the site is in the correct location on the<< inner>> side of the arm.

modes.label: Linking word before outside
modes.description: A small word such as from or that, followed by a location phrase like the outside.
modes.example: bathrooms and bedrooms can be unlocked<< from>> the outside.

card.writes: It pushes toward side-like words and away from inner and internal words, so it favors the outer or opposite term.
card.plain: It lights up on words about inside versus outside, like exterior, internal and inner arm.
